assumptions: NPC Runtime supplies authoritative spawn/reset timing, item targets, and equipment slots.
Classic NPC inventory and equipment source mappings remain unproven and are not auto-projected.
safe_fallback: Reject missing identities, malformed targets, illegal equipment slots, equipment targets above one per slot, and excess existing state without mutation.
runtime_impact: NPC inventory and equipment can reconcile evidence-projected spawn/reset targets while preserving runtime item identities.
character_save_impact: None unless later transferred to a character; NPC-owned item instances remain in world item state.
world_state_impact: Explicitly invoked NPC reconciliation mutates NPC-owned item state without inventing reset scheduling.
